title: ononis reclinata subsp. dentata
intro: Ononis reclinata subsp. dentata, commonly known as the Burdock-leaved Rest-harrow, is a plant species within the legume family. It is a perennial herb with a range of medicinal properties, valued for its health benefits and therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Ononis reclinata subsp. dentata include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
